overrides.purpose: Prospectively validate the phase-aligned discrete calcium-current interface for autonomous voltage-calcium-SK feedback, then judge the unchanged frozen checkpoint families only if the native floor passes.
overrides.source_selection: The formula's next gate state is aligned with the native gate state that contributes current to the voltage update. It is a causal formula-state intermediate, not a teacher future state. This scheme is frozen before the v3 run based on v2 local gate-timing and current audits; no v3 calibration or confirmation outcome selects it.
overrides.decision: Require direct eca=120mV throughout, finite native traces, unchanged 40ms exact-formula/native voltage and calcium floors, and informative coupled-vs-frozen calcium/SK contrasts. Only then judge all six unchanged family-by-seed frozen both-arm candidates on the unchanged 1/2mV voltage, 1e-5mM calcium, 0.01 SK gate, finite/physical/occupancy limits. The 80ms horizon is diagnostic. V1 and v2 decisions remain failed/inadmissible under their own registered interfaces; no retrospective promotion or threshold adjustment.
overrides.scope: One-compartment fixed-eca native CaDynamics/11-channel control with autonomous V and cai; frozen five-channel neural rates; six canonical formula channel rates; analytic calcium and SK current. No synapses, axial coupling, morphology, stochasticity, training or speed claim.
